race.description: Allwood Stud Sires Dbl Westbred Eligible 3yo Westbred C&G Classic Fnl (G2)
race.comment: IDEAL BEACH (6) overcame a back row draw for a win at his latest appearance at Pinjarra, working before scoring by 2.8 metres. Has recorded a win and a placing in two previous third-up attempts so should be at his peak. WHEELSOFORTUNE (1) had a back row draw when resuming at Pinjarra so did well to place, arriving 1.8 metres behind the winner. Proven second-up so should be improved and is much better served by this draw. EL MYSTRO (4) was an impressive winner last start, coming from the back line and cruising home by 17 metres. Won his only previous third-up attempt. Could strike again. Last-start winner HE IS TALKING (3) draws to be competitive again.
